data.name: Eclipse : Special Forces
data.detailed_description:
1,500 years ago, every man vanished. A new world was born.

And now—the wheel of fate begins to turn, by your hand.

Under the blessing of the Creator, La, a world exists where only women remain.

The special forces unit of superpowered women—Eclipse—has long maintained order.

For centuries, peace seemed absolute.

Until a cult known as Apep emerged, and fractures hidden beneath the surface began to spread.

Agent Haesu, an Eclipse operative, uncovers a truth long buried while investigating a terrorist attack.

Amid love, desire, and bloodshed—what choice will she make?

Everything rests in your hands.

Uncover the hidden truths of this world, and shape the future between choice and fate.

Sapphic Bonds — From Eros to Agape

In this world, relationships cannot be defined by a single word.

Love is not singular. Neither is desire.

Between women, emotions unfold across a spectrum—Eros. Philia. Agape.

Devotion and obsession. Faith and longing. Salvation and ruin.

Within these entangled bonds, you will face a single question:

Is this love—or something beyond it?

Choices Shape Destiny — Multiple Endings

Eclipse: Special Forces is an interactive visual novel where every decision alters the course of the story.

Your choices reshape relationships, and ultimately determine the ending itself.

Remember: some choices cannot be undone.

Time Attack System
Will you surrender to fate—or seize it?

At critical moments, a time attack bar appears.

  • Free Will: Decide quickly and carve your own path.

  • Forced Fate: Run out of time, and your choice will be made for you.

Will you entrust yourself to fate—or take control of it?

No one knows which choice is right.

Sometimes, the most dangerous path is the only way forward.

Features

Branching Narrative

A deeply layered story shaped by your choices and emotions.

Time Attack Decision System

Decisions must be made under pressure—or left to fate.

Multiple Endings

Diverging routes and endings based on your decisions.

Visuals

A manga-inspired visual style that brings every moment to life.

  • 124 illustrated scenes

  • Stylized cinematic presentation

  • Immersive storytelling

Experience the sensation of flipping through a graphic novel, combined with the depth of a visual novel.

World

A unique setting where:

  • Egyptian mythology

  • Supernatural abilities

  • Military forces

  • Cults and power struggles

  • And a world inhabited only by women

…intertwine into a grand narrative beneath the sun.

Challenge

Become the Ultimate Agent — 64 Steam Achievements

Discover hidden routes and rare choices.
Complete every achievement and master the world of Eclipse.

This is more than a visual novel.
This is a world waiting to be conquered.

Characters

A world of women—defined by their bonds.

Haesu (The protagonist of Eclipse)

“Mhm, alright. Let’s turn this place upside down.”

Member of Eclipse / Nullification of supernatural powers

While Haesu believes she lacks a strong sense of justice, those around her see her differently. Her unwavering urge to help others has earned her the reputation of being a natural "meddler."

While investigating the 'indiscriminate terror incident,' she gets closer to a shocking truth and finds herself at a crossroads…?

Dallae

“I’d rather die than be on the losing end.”

Member of Eclipse / Illusion manipulation

Haesu’s partner, who uncovered the hidden truth behind the indiscriminate terror incident, holds Haesu in special regard due to their unique bond that has lasted since childhood. However, toward others, she remains indifferent and often acts with cruelty.

The Prophet

"My only choice is to sin to survive and lay bare my sins before our great Mother." 

The commander-in-chief of Eclipse

As the only person capable of hearing the voice of La, the creator of all things, she is revered and venerated as the Spokesperson of the Sun God by all.

Villain A

“May god’s blessings be with you.”

The host of an elite-only party, Haesu and Dalle encounter during their undercover investigation. The mask, depicting a goat—a symbol often associated with evil—adds an eerie and unsettling aura to her presence.

Villain B

“There is no point in knowing, You’re going to die anyway.” 

An individual who moves according to A’s orders, with her name, age, past, and everything else shrouded in mystery.

Villain C

“To those of you living fleeting lives… I shall grant an eternity of hell.” 

A figure harboring profound hostility toward Solarism and Eclipse. She leads those around her with her formidable supernatural power, and wherever she treads, only the pitch-black void of death remains.

Game Info

Genre: Yuri Visual Novel, Superpowers, Military Thriller, Post-Apocalypse
World: A unique blend of Egyptian mythology and a superpowered special forces unit
Languages: Korean, English (professionally localized)

Demo Available

Supported Languages:

  • Korean

  • English ✹ Professionally localized

  • Japanese

  • Simplified Chinese

Love. Desire. Ruin.
Between women, nothing is simple.
Wishlist now—and step into their world.

data.short_description: MEN ARE EXTINCT. ONLY WOMEN REMAIN. Welcome to Eclipse—a choice-driven Yuri VN where God, Kings, Soldiers, and even Villains are all women. As Haesu, an elite agent, your choices will forge her destiny and the very future of the world. Amidst love, desire, and bloodshed—can you handle the truth?

content_descriptors.notes:
A PC visual novel game that follows the story of a member of the special forces unit "Eclipse," who fights against the heretical religious group "Apep" to maintain peace.

Limited Depictions of Violence
(Verbal descriptions and illustrations of violent situations, as well as the depiction of red blood)
(The blood in CG event scenes was mostly depicted in black to lower the intensity, while the blood in short visual effects lasting only a few seconds was rendered in red.)

Moderate Language Use
(Some characters use mild profanity)

Therefore, in accordance with Article 21 of the Act on the Promotion of the Game Industry and Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Game Rating Regulations, the game has been classified as "15 and up."

kgrb.descriptors:
등급 번호: GC-CC-NP-240628-001
등급: 15세 이용가

평화를 지키기 위해 이단 종교 집단 ‘아펩’에 맞서 싸우는 특수부대 ‘이클립스’의 대원이 겪는 이야기를 다룬 PC용 비주얼 노벨 게임

제한적인 폭력성 표현
(폭력적인 상황에 대한 언어적 묘사와 일러스트, 붉은 선혈 표현)

과도하지 않은 언어 표현
(등장인물의 일부 비속어 표현)

따라서 게임산업진흥에 관한 법률 제21조 및 등급분류 규정 제7조제3호에 따라 ‘15세이용가’로 등급분류 결정함.
